import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Button, Box, Paper, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow, Chip } from '@mui/material'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import axios from 'axios'; const InstitutionDashboard = () => { const [applications, setApplications] = useState([]); const [stats, setStats] = useState({ totalApplications: 0, pending: 0, admitted: 0 }); const navigate = useNavigate(); useEffect(() => { fetchApplications(); }, []); const fetchApplications = async () => { try { const response = await axios.get('http://localhost:5000/api/applications/institution'); const apps = response.data.applications; setApplications(apps.slice(0, 5)); // Show only recent 5 const pending = apps.filter(app => app.status === 'pending').length; const admitted = apps.filter(app => app.status === 'admitted').length; setStats({ totalApplications: apps.length, pending, admitted }); } catch (error) { console.error('Error fetching applications:', error); } }; return ( Institution Dashboard Total Applications {stats.totalApplications} Pending {stats.pending} Admitted {stats.admitted} navigate('/applications')}> 📋 Manage Applications Review and process student applications. Admit or reject applicants. navigate('/profile')}> 🏫 Institution Profile Update your institution information and manage courses. {applications.length > 0 && ( Recent Applications Student Course Status Date {applications.map((app) => ( {app.student?.personalInfo?.firstName} {app.student?.personalInfo?.lastName} {app.course?.name} {new Date(app.appliedAt).toLocaleDateString()} ))}
)} ); }; export default InstitutionDashboard;
